basic_details.job_title: NIT Silchar Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electrical Engineering at National Institute of Technology Silchar (NIT Silchar) has invited Indian citizens to apply for one temporary post of Project Associate -I (PA-I) in the ARG (ANRF), Government of India, sponsored project on a multi-port split fast charging system for Low Voltage Electric Vehicles. The project duration is 4 years. Pay is Rs. 37,000 per month for GATE/NET qualified candidates, otherwise Rs. 30,000 per month. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens.

rows.essential_qualification: B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering from recognized university
rows.desirable: M. Tech degree in relevant field and hands-on experience in developing and working on hardware / laboratory prototype of the power electronics converters (will be given preference)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month for candidates who are GATE/NET qualified, and Rs. 30,000/- per month otherwise. The post is temporary, and the project duration is 4 years. Selected candidates shall sign an agreement at the time of joining. All the terms and conditions for this recruitment will be as per the guidelines of the sponsoring agency and NIT Silchar.

content_sections.heading: NIT Silchar Project Associate -I (PA-I) Job Description
content_sections.text: The project involves designing, developing and demonstrating a TRL-6 prototype of a multi-port isolated DC-DC converter for fast charging of LEVs with flexible voltage outputs. The work includes: SiC/GaN-based high-frequency converter design Coordinated dual-bay power allocation Real-time cyber threat detection Fault-tolerant operation for remote locations

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Silchar Project Associate -I (PA-I)
content_sections.text: Fill in the "Format of Application" given on the later pages of the notice. It asks for personal details, educational qualification starting from Class X, NET/GATE details, employment details and a declaration with signature. Paste a recent passport size coloured photograph on the form, as the format provides. Email the soft copy of the duly filled form, with the C.V. and soft copy of all supporting documents, to the PI at [email protected] . Write this subject line: "Application for the post of Project Associate -I under the project ANRF/ARG/2025/007911/ENS". Make sure the soft copy reaches the PI by 30 November 2026. For queries, the PI can be contacted at 9818209336. Documents named in the notice: Duly filled application form (soft copy) C.V. Soft copy of all supporting documents Certificate, if the applicant belongs to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD (the form says to attach it) No objection certificate from the employer, for employed candidates, at the time of interview

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The Institute has the discretion to restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for the interview on the basis of screening. The interview date and mode (online/offline), with other details, will be notified through email. The notice does not print an interview date, time or venue. No candidate may be recruited if suitable candidates are not found.

content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the post. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview. Selected candidates shall have to sign an agreement at the time of joining. The Institute may restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for interview after screening.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIT Silchar Project Associate -I recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice announces 01 (One) temporary post of Project Associate -I (PA-I).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The soft copy of the filled application form must be received by 30 November 2026 (30.11.2026).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the NIT Silchar Project Associate -I post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.Tech/B.E. in Electrical/Electronics Engineering from a recognized university. Candidates with an M. Tech degree in a relevant field and hands-on experience with hardware or laboratory prototypes of power electronics converters will be given preference.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years on the last date of the advertisement. Relaxation is as per Govt. of India Rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the Project Associate -I?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 37,000/- per month for GATE/NET qualified candidates, otherwise Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled application form with C.V. and soft copies of all supporting documents to [email protected]. Use the subject line "Application for the post of Project Associate -I under the project ANRF/ARG/2025/007911/ENS".

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Institute may restrict the number of candidates shortlisted for interview on the basis of screening. The interview date and mode will be notified through email.

faq.question: Q8. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the post.

faq.question: Q9. Do employed candidates need a no objection certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Employed candidates must submit a no objection certificate from their employer at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is the post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The notice calls it a temporary post under a project with a duration of 4 years, and selected candidates sign an agreement at joining.
